cues.text: Under a green sky, Aigis stands on a bridge.
Blue wings of light burst from her back.
Down the road stands Ryoji, in a yellow scarf.
Aigis's eyes narrow.
In grey, she dives from the sky at a dark, cloaked figure.
Fire bursts. Everything goes white.
Sparks fly as she is thrown back.
A cloaked figure with a white skull mask stands on the bridge.
Aigis flips in mid-air, eyes locked on it.
Rockets flare. She slams into the figure with a red blade of light.
Smoke billows. The masked figure looms through it.
A beam of light strikes the middle of the bridge.
A flash. Aigis's eyes glow blue.
She staggers, shedding sparks of light.
Her Persona appears, a towering armoured figure.
Light explodes.
Smoke rises from Aigis.
One eye glows red. Sparks crackle across her chest.
Lightning crackles over her.
Warnings flash red. A figure in her sights: Unknown.
